about:
United Fabrication, LLC operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it has specialized in sheet metal fabrication since 2005. The company is privately held; no founders are named in public materials.

The shop provides end-to-end sheet metal services: design and prototyping from CAD models or blueprints, manufacturing with a typical processing window of two to three weeks, and finishing options that include anodizing, powder coating, or raw surfaces. Final inspection, packaging, and delivery complete the workflow; local delivery covers the Salt Lake Valley, and shipping is available to other destinations.

Customers span sectors that require bracketry, electronic chassis, medical equipment enclosures, and mining equipment components. The company works directly with engineers and procurement teams to move projects from concept to finished parts.

United Fabrication emphasizes continual advancement of its manufacturing processes and close collaboration with clients, positioning itself as a partner capable of handling complex fabrications without minimum order constraints.
